header.name: billing_followup_dev
header.purpose: Development set for reading a question about an invoice or charge as billing_question and a follow-up on an earlier message or booking as other, with pricing and policy questions as look-alikes that must keep their own intent. Written for D-086. None of these messages is copied from the tuned, held-out or sealed items. Not a result.

items.body: Hi, I sent a message on Tuesday about the sewer camera quote. Has anyone had a chance to look at it?
Did you receive the pictures of the cracked shower valve I sent this morning?
Just checking that my appointment tomorrow is still on. I have not had a confirmation.
Following up on my earlier email about the faucet install. Any news?
I haven't heard back about the water heater estimate. Can you let me know where it stands?
Hi again, wanted to make sure you got my last message about the leak check.
Any update on the price you were going to send me for the bathroom job?
Can you confirm you got the form with my property details? I sent it Monday.
Checking in on the quote I asked for last week for the disposal install.
Is the technician still coming this afternoon? Nobody has called me.
Just following up, I never got a reply about the drain cleaning I asked about.
Hello, did my earlier message go through? There was an error when I sent it.
Is there tax on labour on the final bill, or only on the parts?
My invoice shows a $150 evening surcharge. Can you explain what that covers?
Can you send me a copy of my invoice from the job on Maple Street? I lost the email.
The total on my bill is higher than the number I was quoted over the phone. What happened?
When is payment due on my invoice, and can I pay it by card?
I was charged twice for the same visit. Can you check my account?
Why is there a line called disposal fee on my invoice?
The receipt you emailed has the wrong address on it. Can it be corrected?
Please itemise the charges on invoice KH-3302. I only see one total.
My statement shows a deposit I do not remember paying. Can you look into it?
After you fixed the faucet I got a bill with an extra half hour of labour on it. Is that right?
How much do you charge to replace a toilet fill valve?
What is your call-out fee for a Sunday evening visit?
Roughly what would a new shower faucet cost installed?
Do you charge extra for emergency visits at night?
What is the price of a camera inspection of a sewer line?
Is there a fee just to come and look at a leaking pipe?
Do your prices include parts or just labour?
What is your cancellation policy if I need to move a visit?
Does the workmanship warranty cover parts as well as labour?
Does someone over 18 need to be home during the visit?
